chunks: Ibn Muskan narrated from Ibrāhīm ibn Isḥāq, from someone who asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
About a woman who performed four circuits while she was performing ʿUmrah, then she menstruated. He said:

"She should complete her tawaf, and nothing else is due from her. Her tamattuʿ is complete, and she may perform saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah because she has gone beyond half, and she has completed her tamattuʿ. So let her recommence after Hajj. But if she had not performed except three circuits, then let her recommence after Hajj. If her camel-driver remains with her after Hajj, then let her go out to al-Jiʿrānah or to al-Tanʿīm and perform ʿUmrah."

key_terms.الْجِعْرَانَةِ: al-Jiʿrānah, a place from which iḥrām for ʿUmrah may be entered
key_terms.طَافَتْ: she performed the circuits of tawaf
key_terms.مُعْتَمِرَةٌ: a woman in the state of performing ʿUmrah

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman menstruates during tawaf in ʿUmrah after completing four circuits?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a woman performing ʿUmrah who begins menstruating during tawaf. It distinguishes between completing more than half of the tawaf and completing less than that, and explains what she should do regarding saʿy and renewing the ʿUmrah after Hajj.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2767 - Ibn Muskan narrated from Ibrahim ibn Ishaq, from someone who asked Abu Abdullah (as)

about a woman performing ‘Umrah who completed four rounds of tawaf and then began menstruating.
Imam (as) said: "

She should complete her tawaf, and nothing more is required of her. Her tamattu‘ is valid, and she may perform sa‘i between Safa and Marwa because she has completed more than half of the tawaf and thus fulfilled her tamattu‘. After Hajj, she does not need to repeat anything. However, if she had completed only three rounds of tawaf, she must repeat it after Hajj. If her caravan stays in Mecca after Hajj, she should go to al-Ji‘ranah or Tan‘im and perform another ‘Umrah."
